text_block_list.text:
One day, I went to check in on
Admire Groove's dance lesson—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: This choreography... looks like it'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fuehhhh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Put this hand here, and then like this... huh?
Wait, this looks different from the reference video...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Perhaps I should double-check, just in case.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The image is... of a grand goal, a dream.
Grabbing hold of it with all my mightâ

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: With these very hands...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ohh... oh! Like this, right!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~, thanks.
That was super helpful~~.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Reference material...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The part Alv-chan showed me was
exactly where I was stumbling~~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“This is for me, right?
Ehehe, thank you so much~~”

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I have no idea what you're talking about.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I just thought...
I should check once more."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, I see♪
Admire Groove's lesson seemed to have finished, so I called out to her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll be heading out now.
Thank you for your hard work."
choice_data_list: You were really good at teaching.
You're such a kind person, huh.
You're such a kind person, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll be heading out now.
Thank you for your hard work."
choice_data_list: You were really good at teaching.
You're such a kind person, huh.
You're such a kind person, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
............
I was merely dancing, after all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Being praised like that... puts me in a spot.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Even you...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...There is no deeper meaning.
This conversation is over.
